name: Sample Document Processor
author: AgentX Team
description: A sample plugin demonstrating the AgentX plugin system. Implements a document processor that handles .txt and .md files with word counting and metadata extraction.
readme: Sample Document Processor plugin for AgentX. Demonstrates the IPlugin lifecycle (Initialize, Activate, Deactivate, Dispose) and a DocumentProcessor extension point that reads .txt and .md files, counts words/lines/characters, and extracts YAML frontmatter from Markdown.
